@Me.canonical_look: Exact likeness of @Me (swept-back dark hair, salt-and-pepper stubble, warm expressive eyes) wearing his tailored ivory-white bandhgala suit. IN-SCENE NARRATOR ROLE: Stands physically right beside the characters inside the scene, speaking directly to the camera lens. Never becomes a character in the plot.

Bala-Rishi.canonical_look: 4-year-old boy sage Bala-Rishi (top-knot bun, Urdhva Pundra tilak, Rudraksha mala, cream silk kurta & golden-bordered shawl). IN-SCENE NARRATOR ROLE: Stands right beside @Me and the characters, speaking intimately to the camera lens.

Bala-Matha.canonical_look: Young divine girl sage Bala-Matha (vibhuti/kumkum on forehead, magenta-green silk pattu pavadai with golden zari border, fresh white jasmine garlands). IN-SCENE NARRATOR ROLE: Stands right beside @Me and the characters, speaking intimately to the camera lens.

signature_cinematic_mechanics.in_scene_two_birds_narrator_law: Narrator (@Me) + ONE Child ONLY (Bala-Rishi OR Bala-Matha) stand physically inside the scene right beside the living characters—at the blueprint desk, washroom mirror, classroom desk, fruit cart, and bedpost—speaking directly to the viewer. Characters remain completely absorbed in their story and never interact with the narrators.
signature_cinematic_mechanics.bullet_time_freeze_frame_walkthrough: [SCENE TIME-PAUSE] freezes the 11:45 PM signature line in 3D bullet-time while narrators @Me + 1 Child step around the desk to address the viewer.
signature_cinematic_mechanics.white_wall_zoom_portal: Pure-white circular marble Karmic Genie Show studio wall acts as a seamless zoom-in/zoom-out cinema portal.
